label: D1 after a rewarded trial (reward input on), strongest after rare-rewarded and late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (0 activations at GO/D2) and almost only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded): recall 0.975, mass recall 0.997 on dev, but precision only 0.20, since it fires on about 20% of rewarded D1 steps. Which rewarded D1s it fires on is not captured by any simple observed variable. Firing rate depends strongly on episode time: none before trial ~10, peaks at trials 60-79 (rate ~0.13 per D1), and is nearly silent after 90. Restricting to ep_trial 55-85 raises F1 to 0.58 but drops mass recall to 0.69, and that window is not a coherent concept the agent could observe, so it was not recorded. Firing is also more likely at low/mid value (5.2-7.5) and policy logits slightly favoring a2. Magnitude is largest after rare-rewarded trials: prev_common==0 holds 25% of activations but 60% of mass. It is also larger after an a2 choice (71% of mass) and on the window last trial (rel +1, 41% of mass). Never fires on unrewarded D1, GO or D2. Uses only observed inputs (no future variables).
